experiments.name: Direction A: M3 Expressive Cobalt Studio

userPreferences: Avoid repetitive pill buttons and flat uniform border cages
Avoid overly concentrated beige/tan tones that flatten contrast
Adopt authentic Material 3 Expressive (tonal surface elevation, connected groups, shape morphing, split CTA, ripples)
Keep outer corners smooth without radius overshoot clipping during connected-group selection switches
Select Direction A (Cobalt Studio); discard Direction B
Design all 5 application pages matching the Direction A M3 Expressive system
Keep selected gallery items blue and slightly deepen blue when hovered+selected instead of reverting to unselected hover surface
Use Material 3 Expressive Shimmer Skeleton Loading placeholders whenever elements or images have not finished loading
Apply consistent radial click/tap ripple feedback across all interactive clickable elements while reusing a shared implementation
